title: Manifest v1
description: The run manifest accepted by POST /v1/projects/{p}/manifests (05.1.1-T1.1/T1.2, 00 §9.3). It declares the suite revision, the planned executions (case revision × variant params × target env), the matrix those executions cover, the shard plan that partitions them and the per-environment needs. Bounds are encoded here: at most 10000 planned executions, 256 shards, 32 target environments, 32 variant params; the transport cap is 256 KiB [DECISION 05.1.1 §8]. Semantic checks — unknown case revision, secret literal in variant params, matrix coverage — are 05.1.1-T2's; this schema only fixes the shape.

environment_revision_id.description: Optional in V1: environment_revision is created by 05.1.2-T1, which adds the composite FK (org_id, environment_revision_id)

case_revision_ids.description: Distinct ids; duplicates are matrix_not_covered (05.1.1-T2.4, a linear check). Deliberately no uniqueItems: the validators compare items pairwise, so 10000 ids would cost seconds per request.

variants.description: The variant axis; planned_executions must equal case_revision_ids × variants × target_envs (05.1.1-T2.4)

shards.description: One entry per producer slot (05.2.1 registers one per shard); the index ranges partition planned_executions exactly (05.1.1-T2.4)

required.description: Absent means required (05.2.1 planned_execution.required defaults true); an optional tuple is reported but cannot by itself make the run complete

params.description: Normalised secret-free variant parameters (03.2.1): the server hashes them into variant_hash, and execution_key = sha256(case_id ‖ variant_hash ‖ target_env) (00 §7). A literal where a secret is meant is rejected by 05.1.1-T2.3, not by this schema.

to_index.description: Exclusive end index into planned_executions; a shard owns [from_index, to_index)

producer_hint.description: Versioned producer metadata for the pool; never authoritative (00 §5.4.5)

target_envs.description: One entry per target env of the matrix; secrets are references only (00 §5.7 S3)
